breakfast.name: Ham + cheddar egg bites
ingredients: 6 oz diced ham (or a ham steak, diced)
steps: On Sunday, heat the oven to 350 F and spray a 12-cup muffin tin well.
Divide the ham, broccoli, and green onions among the cups.
Whisk the eggs, cottage cheese, garlic powder, a pinch of salt, and pepper, then pour into the cups about three-quarters full.
Top with the cheddar and bake 20 to 22 minutes until set in the center.
Cool, then refrigerate in a sealed container.
To serve, microwave 2 egg bites per person for 45 to 60 seconds and eat with a clementine or two.

lunch.name: Strawberry-peach smoothie
ingredients: Optional: a squeeze of lime, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, or a few ice cubes
steps: Add almond milk and yogurt to the blender first.
Add protein powder, spinach, strawberries, peaches, almond butter, and chia seeds.
Blend on high 45 to 60 seconds until smooth, adding a splash of water if too thick.
Pour into two glasses and drink right away.

dinner.name: Greek chicken sheet pan
ingredients: 1 1/4 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut in 1 1/2-inch pieces
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a sheet pan.
Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp oil, the lemon zest, juice of half the lemon, garlic, oregano, 3/4 tsp salt, and pepper.
Toss the zucchini, onion, and tomatoes with the remaining oil, salt, and pepper and spread everything on the pan.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes until the chicken reaches 165 F.
Stir the rest of the lemon juice and a pinch of salt into the yogurt.
Sprinkle the pan with feta and serve with the lemon yogurt sauce.

breakfast.name: Apple-cinnamon oats
steps: The night before, whisk almond milk, Greek yogurt, protein powder, and cinnamon until smooth.
Stir in the oats, chia seeds, and diced apple, divide between two jars, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, stir, add a splash of milk if thick, and top with the walnuts.

dinner.name: Moroccan turkey skillet
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the onion 3 minutes.
Add the turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink, 5 to 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, paprika, cinnamon, and 3/4 tsp salt for 30 seconds.
Add the chickpeas and tomatoes and simmer 6 to 8 minutes until thickened.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Serve with a spoonful of yogurt, parsley, and lemon.

dinner.name: Lemon chicken orzo soup
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots, and celery 5 minutes.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the broth, thyme, 1/2 tsp salt, and the whole chicken breasts.
Bring to a simmer and cook 15 minutes until the chicken reaches 165 F. Move the chicken to a board and shred it with two forks.
Add the orzo to the pot and simmer 8 to 9 minutes until tender.
Return the chicken, stir in the spinach until wilted, then the lemon juice and parsley. Season to taste.

dinner.name: Pork chops + apples
ingredients: 2 boneless pork chops (about 6 oz each, 3/4 inch thick)
steps: Season the chops with the thyme, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chops 4 to 5 minutes per side until 145 F. Move to a plate and tent with foil.
Add the remaining oil and the Brussels sprouts cut-side down with a pinch of salt. Cook 5 to 6 minutes until browned.
Add the apple and onion and cook 3 minutes, then pour in the broth, cover, and steam 3 minutes until the sprouts are tender.
Stir in the Dijon and maple, return the chops and any juices, and serve.

dinner.name: Shrimp scampi zoodles
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the shrimp 1 to 2 minutes per side until pink. Move to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium, add the butter, garlic, and pepper flakes for 30 seconds, then the broth and tomatoes for 2 minutes.
Add the zucchini noodles and toss 2 to 3 minutes until just tender (don't overcook or they get watery).
Return the shrimp, add the juice of half the lemon, and serve with Parmesan, parsley, and lemon wedges.

breakfast.name: Mushroom feta scramble
steps: Cook the turkey bacon in a nonstick skillet over medium heat until crisp, about 6 minutes. Move to a plate.
Add the oil and mushrooms and cook 4 minutes until browned, then wilt the spinach for 1 minute.
Whisk the eggs with pepper, pour them in, and stir slowly over medium-low heat until softly set, 2 to 3 minutes.
Sprinkle with feta and serve with the turkey bacon and strawberries.

lunch.name: Leftover chicken soup
ingredients: 2 portions lemon chicken orzo soup (from Wednesday)
steps: Reheat the soup in a pot over medium heat or in the microwave until steaming, adding a splash of broth or water if it has thickened.
Serve topped with Parmesan, black pepper, and a squeeze of lemon.

dinner.name: Steak fajita sheet pan
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, sliced thin against the grain
4 small whole wheat tortillas or romaine leaves
steps: Heat the oven to 450 F and line a sheet pan.
Toss the peppers and onion with 1 tbsp oil, half the spices, and salt, and roast 10 minutes.
Toss the steak with the remaining oil, spices, and 1/2 tsp salt.
Add the steak to the pan in a single layer and roast 6 to 8 minutes until browned and just cooked.
Squeeze the lime over everything and serve in tortillas or romaine with avocado, yogurt, and salsa.

breakfast.name: Banana protein pancakes
steps: Blend the banana, eggs, oats, cottage cheese, protein powder, baking powder, and cinnamon until smooth. Let sit 3 minutes.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat and spray lightly.
Pour 1/4-cup scoops and cook 2 minutes until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Serve topped with the Greek yogurt and blueberries.

lunch.name: Tuna white bean wraps
ingredients: 2 cans (5 oz) tuna in water, drained
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the tuna, beans, celery, tomatoes, red onion, and parsley and toss gently.
Spoon into romaine leaves and eat like tacos.

dinner.name: Lemon-dill salmon
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a sheet pan.
Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt, and pepper and roast 15 minutes.
Toss the asparagus with the remaining oil and salt. Push the potatoes aside, add the asparagus and salmon, and season the salmon with 1 tsp dill, the garlic, salt, pepper, and lemon slices.
Roast 10 to 12 minutes until the salmon flakes easily (145 F).
Mix the yogurt with the remaining dill and a squeeze of lemon and serve on the side.
